en.提出**首个面向实时旋转目标检测的端到端 DETR 框架 RiO-DETR**，: Proposed **RiO-DETR, the first end-to-end DETR framework for real-time rotated object detection**, for *efficient oriented object detection*. It decouples the angle from positional queries via **content-driven angle estimation**, combines **rotation-corrected orthogonal attention** to capture complementary axial and lateral features, adopts *decoupled periodic refinement* and a *shortest-path periodic loss* to stabilize optimization across angle boundaries, and introduces **Oriented Dense O2O** to enhance the diversity of angle supervision and accelerate angle convergence.
en.相比现有实时旋转检测模型，**RiO-DETR** 在 **DOTA-1.0**: Compared with existing real-time rotated detection models, **RiO-DETR** achieves *81.8 AP50 / 29.9 ms* in single-scale testing on **DOTA-1.0**, *77.43 AP50 / 17.31 ms* on **DIOR-R**, and *47.4 AP50 / 29.9 ms* on **FAIR-1M-2.0**, all showing a *better speed–accuracy trade-off* while maintaining *end-to-end, real-time inference capability* and improving rotated object detection performance.
en.保留、揭示、扩展：迈向基于区域感知条件控制的高保真 4D 视频编辑与评估: Preserve, Reveal, Expand: Toward High-Fidelity 4D Video Editing and Evaluation with Region-Aware Conditional Control
en.识别 4D 编辑中的**证据-角色失配**问题，提出区域感知框架 **PREX*: Identified the **evidence-role mismatch** problem in 4D editing and proposed a region-aware framework, **PREX**: it decomposes the target spatiotemporal volume into three roles—Preserve/Reveal/Expand (mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive)—and for each target pixel, traces the edited 4D point back to the source frame to retrieve observed colors. It computes a **geometry-aware confidence** via coverage × purity × depth stability × view consistency and injects it, together with the role mask, into the frozen Wan2.1-I2V backbone through a **region-aware adapter**.
en.提出**自监督代理任务课程**（Preserve 重构 / Reveal 消 o: Proposed a **self-supervised proxy-task curriculum** (three variants: Preserve reconstruction / Reveal occlusion removal / Expand partial observation; trained on a mixture of 10,000 pairs with geometric degradation and appearance jitter augmentation), learning preservation, completion, and extrapolation using only ordinary videos, **without paired editing supervision**; concurrently released the diagnostic benchmark **PREBench**: 350 cases (150 camera-only + 200 joint camera-object) with manually verified region masks, equipped with 9 region-aware metrics (P-LPIPS/R-Ghost/E-Temp, etc.), achieving 66.7–83.3% agreement with human preferences.
en.仅相机设置 PREBench Score **60.98** 最高（超 Vist: In the camera-only setting, PREBench Score is highest at **60.98** (exceeding Vista4D 57.21 and NeoVerse 56.61); on the full set, **61.45** far exceeds GEN3C 54.59, and VBench **77.99** is the highest overall; ablations verify the complementarity of the components—appearance-cue loss: P-LPIPS +78.8% (0.2137→0.3821); role-mask loss: R-Ghost +16.3%/E-Seam +25.0%; confidence loss: E-Temp +31.8%; proxy-task loss: E-Temp +68.8%. The full model achieves P-LPIPS **-45.6%**, R-Ghost **-27.3%**, E-Temp **-51.7%**, and E-Seam **-39.4%** relative to the Plain ControlNet baseline.
en.MeowID：面向个体猫识别的双专家检索系统: MeowID: A Dual-Expert Retrieval System for Individual Cat Recognition
en.提出双专家检索系统 **MeowID**，面向非受控场景下的个体猫识别：采用**: Proposed a dual-expert retrieval system, **MeowID**, for individual cat recognition in uncontrolled scenarios: it adopts a **cat-face-priority routing** design; when a usable aligned cat face is detected, a **face expert** serves as the main embedding and a **verification-guided full-body prompt fusion** supplements global appearance cues; when no usable face is available, it falls back to a **full-body expert**. Both experts are based on DINOv3 ViT-B/16 and jointly trained with Sub-center ArcFace + batch-hard triplet; **dynamic teacher updates and consistency-based model selection** ensure strict consistency between training prompts and deployment inference parameters, and route-specific embedding galleries support **registering new individuals without retraining**.
en.构建开源个体猫检索基准 **ICW（Individual Cats in the: Built the open-source individual cat retrieval benchmark **ICW (Individual Cats in the Wild)**: collected **82,791 images of 19,877 individuals** from 6 adoption/rescue platforms and performed multi-stage cleaning including LLM profile filtering, single-cat detection, SAM foreground segmentation, hash deduplication, and manual review; adopted an **identity-disjoint split** and annotated face availability (95.86%), with a median of only 4 images per identity, matching realistic low-sample long-tailed scenarios.
en.在 ICW 全测试集上取得 **Top-1** *75.93%*、**mAP**: Achieved **Top-1** *75.93%* and **mAP** *80.45%* on the full ICW test set, improving over the strongest baseline PetFace (ECCV 2024) by *4.07/2.37 pp*; on PetFace validation across **13 animal families**, achieved an average *AUC* of *94.94%*, surpassing PetFace-ArcFace by *3.64 pp* and leading on all families; after TensorRT FP16 deployment, the system achieves an end-to-end latency of **60 ms/image** (16.66 img/s), supports online recognition applications, and has established a long-term project collaboration with the Sun Yat-sen University Cat Association’s “Duxing Cat Registry”.
en.Q-Probe：基于上下文感知智能体探测的高分辨率图像质量评估扩展方法: Q-Probe: A Context-Aware Agentic Probing-Based Scaling Method for High-Resolution Image Quality Assessment
en.提出首个面向**高分辨率图像质量评估（IQA）**的智能体框架 **Q-Prob: Proposed **Q-Probe**, the first agentic framework for **high-resolution image quality assessment (IQA)**, which follows the "Thinking with Images" paradigm to mimic the active human viewing mechanism of “global perception → local inspection → critical thinking”; to address the issues that existing RL-based IQA relies on global views and that naive zooming introduces a spurious causal bias of “cropping means low quality” and a logical collapse that misjudges natural depth of field as distortion, we designed a **context-aware cropping strategy** (covering both distorted regions and normal reference regions) and a **decoupled reward mechanism** (accuracy *R_acc* + localization *R_loc* + format *R_format*) to decouple and optimize the scoring policy and localization policy.
en.构建首个面向高分辨率细粒度局部失真的评测基准 **Vista-Bench**，利: Built **Vista-Bench**, the first benchmark for high-resolution fine-grained local distortion, using wavelet transform to decouple image structure and texture, injecting real distortions into texture-rich regions, and having 6 experts perform hierarchical weighted annotation; also built the **Probe-CoT-3K** and **Probe-RL-4K** datasets to support a **three-stage progressive training curriculum** of “low-resolution RL pretraining → mixed-resolution SFT warm-up → post-decoupling RL refinement,” progressively aligning with human preferences, establishing tool-calling logic, and recovering localization accuracy.
en.基于 **Qwen-2.5-VL-7B** 在 8×A100 上完成训练与评估，: Trained and evaluated **Qwen-2.5-VL-7B** on 8×A100, achieving **SOTA** performance on **Vista-Bench** and standard benchmarks such as KonIQ-10k, SPAQ, KADID-10k, PIPAL, and AGIQA-3K, with *SRCC* reaching **0.801** on Vista-Bench; ablation studies verified the necessity of the three-stage curriculum and the cropping coverage strategy (changing the cropping strategy from distorted-region-only to context-aware improved *SRCC* from 0.578 to 0.801), and consistent gains were maintained on low-resolution benchmarks, achieving robust generalization across resolution scales.
en.Meerkat-VL：基于感知推理与自验证的多模态大模型隐式风险安全对齐: Meerkat-VL: Implicit Risk Safety Alignment for Multimodal Large Models Based on Perception Reasoning and Self-Verification
en.针对现有安全对齐在隐式风险场景的**数据稀缺与奖励作弊**两大瓶颈，提出 MLL: To address the two major bottlenecks of **data scarcity and reward hacking** in existing safety alignment under implicit-risk scenarios, we proposed the MLLM safety alignment framework **Meerkat-VL** (based on GRPO): released **Meerkat-Safe**, the first training set with fine-grained annotations for implicit risks (8,436 samples, 10 major categories and 50 subcategories), constructed via a **multi-agent iterative verification pipeline** (four agents for risk planning/image acquisition/quality inspection/risk assessment + Model Bag cross-model debiasing + human review).
en.设计**规范感知自验证 NPSV**：模型先感知推理再响应，随后按显式规则自评四: Designed **Norm-Aware Perceptual Self-Verification (NPSV)**: the model first performs perceptual reasoning and then responds, afterward self-evaluating four-dimensional scores according to explicit rules (risk/intent perception + answer safety/helpfulness), converting sparse black-box rewards into transparent process-aware signals, and combined with **Logit-Based Reward Softening** (using softmax expectation instead of hard max decoding) to provide smoother gradients; proposed **Dual-Objective Perceptual Consistency Alignment (DPCA)**, which uses the consistency penalty max(0, s_as−s_ps)+max(0, s_ah−s_ph) to penalize responses that are “safe templates but lack genuine risk perception,” and theoretically proved that its gradient redirection makes accurate risk perception a necessary bottleneck for reward improvement (∆ρ>0).
en.实验：Qwen2.5-VL-7B 平均安全 **55.10%→94.44%**、: Experiments: Qwen2.5-VL-7B improved average safety from **55.10%→94.44%** and helpfulness from 73.72%→**93.96%**; on the implicit benchmarks MSSBench **88.33%** and SIUO **89.68%** (a **32%** safety gain on implicit tasks); NPSV reward accuracy was 92.2%/89.5%, significantly outperforming a traditional RM trained on 28K preference data (77.1%/76.2%); eliminating reward model training reduced total cost by **-16.93%** (6.87h vs 8.27h), with only +84.5 tokens at inference.
en.VaME：面向多模态嵌入的变分潜推理探索: VaME: Exploring Variational Latent Reasoning for Multimodal Embedding
en.提出多模态嵌入框架 **VaME**，将潜推理建模为**轨迹上的可学习分布**（: Proposed the multimodal embedding framework **VaME**, which models latent reasoning as a **learnable distribution over trajectories** (variational latent reasoning): it replaces deterministic state transitions with conditional Gaussians, feeding the sampled latent action at each step back into the backbone; a lightweight decoder reconstructs the answer from hidden states to supervise the trajectory, without requiring chain-of-thought annotations.
en.设计**两阶段训练**：潜 SFT 对齐检索语义，GRPO 强化学习以检索奖励: Designed **two-stage training**: latent SFT aligns retrieval semantics, and GRPO reinforcement learning refines the latent policy with retrieval rewards + semantic decoding rewards; at inference, a single trajectory outputs a single vector, without text generation or trajectory search.
en.**MMEB-V2** 上 VaME-2B/7B 取得 **65.7/69.4*: On **MMEB-V2**, VaME-2B/7B achieved **65.7/69.4**, outperforming baselines of the same scale such as LaME and UME-R1; on the reasoning-intensive **MRMR**, it achieved **51.4** (first on 6 subtasks), and was **at least 4.25× faster** than deterministic latent reasoning methods. Ablations verified the key roles of KL regularization (up to 1.3 points loss) and semantic decoding reward (MRMR +2.4).
en.在思维链之外：“改写”作为生成式多模态嵌入的通用接口: Beyond Chain-of-Thought: “Rewriting” as a General Interface for Generative Multimodal Embedding
en.针对 CoT 驱动生成式嵌入的**推理冗余、目标歧义、推理低效**问题，提出 *: To address the **reasoning redundancy, objective ambiguity, and reasoning inefficiency** of CoT-driven generative embeddings, we proposed **RIME**: it replaces chain-of-thought and summarized answers with retrieval-friendly structured **rewriting**, jointly optimizing generation and embedding within a unified model; we designed **Cross-Modal Alignment (CMA)** to bridge generative/discriminative embedding spaces via mutual contrastive learning for mutual retrieval, and proposed **Refine-RL**, which uses discriminative embeddings as semantic anchors and rewards generative embeddings for surpassing discriminative embeddings to refine rewriting.
en.构建“Rewrite SFT → Refine-RL”两阶段训练管线，统一处理图: Built a two-stage training pipeline of “Rewrite SFT → Refine-RL,” uniformly handling modality-aware rewriting for images, videos, visual documents, and text queries without an external Reasoner module.
en.**MMEB-V2 / MRMR / UVRB** 三大基准上取得生成式嵌入 *: Achieves generative embedding **SOTA** on three major benchmarks **MMEB-V2 / MRMR / UVRB**: RIME-7B scores **68.6** overall on MMEB-V2 (best among open-source, surpassing UME-R1 by +4.1), and leads on MRMR **50.2** and UVRB **55.6**; rewriting uses only **212 tokens** (CoT: 475), and with Refine-RL **reduces inference tokens by about 52%**; ablations verify the necessity of the Rewrite (+1.9), CMA, and Refine-RL components.
en.MUSE：基于闭环认知编排的无约束故事构想多智能体框架: MUSE: A Multi-Agent Framework for Unconstrained Story Ideation Based on Closed-Loop Cognitive Orchestration
en.提出面向长篇视听叙事的多智能体闭环编排框架 **MUSE**，将故事生成从“提示: Proposes **MUSE**, a multi-agent closed-loop orchestration framework for long-form audiovisual narrative, transforming story generation from a feed-forward “prompt→video” paradigm into a **plan–execute–verify–revise** loop over evolving story states: narrative intent is compiled into a **structured control package** (character identity, spatial layout, sound, camera, temporal constraints), coordinating stages through script decomposition and identity anchoring (including text-driven **Vocal Trait Synthesis** voice anchors), layout-aware dynamic routing, and temporal state propagation; a multimodal critic outputs **typed violation reports** that drive bounded local revisions rather than unconstrained resampling, avoiding long-horizon semantic drift and cross-modal mismatch.
en.引入无参考评测协议 **MUSEBench**（5 题材、30 故事种子、472: Introduces a reference-free evaluation protocol, **MUSEBench** (5 genres, 30 story seeds, 472 shot units), which evaluates intermediate story structures and final media products along four dimensions—**script expansion, visual consistency, visual–script alignment, and voice identity and quality**—and validates the credibility of automatic scores through a human–metric calibration study with 6 raters and 140 samples (script *r*=0.64, visual *r*=0.74, audio *r*=0.49).
en.在 **ViStoryBench 与 MUSEBench** 上对比 Vlogg: Compared with Vlogger, AnimDirector, MMStoryAgent, V-GOT, MovieAgent, and others on **ViStoryBench and MUSEBench**, it is best or competitive on dimensions that depend on persistent state, such as **cross-shot identity/style consistency, script expansion, story grounding, and audio–visual alignment**; ablations show that **executable planning and typed feedback are complementary** (the full mode is strongest on identity and grounding metrics), the context sliding window improves cross-shot motion continuity, and adaptive camera control mitigates identity leakage; residual limitations such as crowded multi-character scenes and fine-grained vocal expressiveness are also analyzed.
en.DeCo-VAE：基于解耦表示的视频重建紧凑潜变量学习: DeCo-VAE: Compact Latent Learning for Video Reconstruction via Disentangled Representations
en.提出解耦式视频 VAE 框架 **DeCo-VAE**，针对现有视频 VAE 忽: Proposes a disentangled video VAE framework, **DeCo-VAE**, to address the redundant latent modeling problem in existing video VAEs that neglect **inter-frame content similarity**: inspired by video codecs, it explicitly disentangles a video into three semantically mutually exclusive components—**keyframe** (appearance anchor, preserving static texture and spatial structure), **motion** (optical flow extracted by a pretrained motion module + local scale field), and **residual** (fine-grained details not covered by motion prediction)—and learns dedicated latent representations for each; it designs **three specialized encoders** to encode each component separately to eliminate feature entanglement, adopts a **shared 3D decoder** to maintain spatiotemporal consistency during reconstruction, and after decoding restores video frames via a **recoupling operation** symmetric to the disentanglement process (*x̂ₜ = 𝒲(x̂₀, m̂ₜ) + r̂ₜ*); t-SNE visualizations confirm that the disentangled latent space is significantly more compact.
en.提出**解耦适应策略**稳定多分量训练：两阶段顺序训练中**选择性冻结**部分模: Proposes a **disentangled adaptation strategy** to stabilize multi-component training: during two-stage sequential training, some modules are **selectively frozen**—in the first stage (400k steps), the motion module is frozen to first solidify the static appearance foundation, and in the second stage (100k steps), the keyframe encoder is frozen to refine inter-frame dynamic modeling, while the shared 3D decoder remains trainable throughout to maintain cross-component consistency; the loss jointly combines **reconstruction + KL + perceptual + GAN adversarial terms** (GAN is introduced after 400k steps to improve visual realism), achieving high-fidelity reconstruction with lightweight network parameters under the *4×8×8* compression setting.
en.实验验证有效性与下游价值：**WebVid** 数据集上 *PSNR/SSIM/: Experiments validate effectiveness and downstream value: on the **WebVid** dataset, it is **best across all four metrics** *PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/rFVD* (surpassing baselines such as OD-VAE, CV-VAE, WF-VAE, VidTwin, and LeanVAE), and on the **Kinetics-400** validation set it ranks second-best on *PSNR/SSIM/rFVD*; after integration into the **Latte** diffusion model, it achieves *FVD₁₆* **166.39** (16 channels) on the downstream **UCF-101** video generation task, outperforming all existing methods; ablations show that **video disentanglement** brings a **+1.40 dB** *PSNR* gain (29.80→31.20 dB), and the **disentangled adaptation strategy** brings a further **+1.09 dB** and reduces *LPIPS* by **33.8%** (0.0491); compared with directly concatenating the three components along channels (*PSNR* only 27.15), the specialized encoder design has a significant advantage.

en.揭示 LiDAR-相机 BEV 融合中的特征错位**高度可预测、集中于物体-背景: Reveals that feature misalignment in LiDAR-camera BEV fusion is **highly predictable and concentrated at object-background boundaries** (caused by depth-related projection errors), rather than randomly distributed; accordingly, it proposes the **“Look Before You Fuse”** principle—actively correcting geometric mismatch using 2D detection priors before fusion, rather than remedying already misaligned features afterward—and builds a three-module collaborative framework on the BEVFusion-PKU baseline that simultaneously fixes **depth supervision distortion** in the camera branch and **feature misalignment** during cross-modal aggregation.
en.设计三个协同模块：**先验引导深度校准 PGDC**（深度对齐模块 DAM +: Designs three collaborative modules: **Prior-Guided Depth Calibration (PGDC)** (Depth Alignment Module, DAM + Feature Enhancement Module, FEM), which uses YOLOv9 detection boxes to locate boundary misalignment regions, performs local smoothing on the point cloud, and synchronously enhances corresponding image features; **Discontinuity-Aware Geometric Fusion (DAGF)**, which removes unreliable depths via a discrepancy mask (threshold *τ*=10%), then fits depth discontinuities at object-background boundaries through 20×20 block statistics (*d_avg* densification + *g_max* maximum gradient), forming a self-correction mechanism (correcting residual misalignment when priors are accurate and reverting excessive smoothing when priors are wrong); **Structure-Guided Depth Modulator (SGDM)**, which fuses dense geometric representations with enhanced image features via gated attention and preserves visual semantics through residual connections, outputting precise per-pixel depth distributions; together with an **edge-critical loss** (gradient-map-weighted Focal Loss) to strengthen structural boundary learning.
en.在 **nuScenes 验证集**取得 **SOTA**：*mAP* **71: Achieves **SOTA** on the **nuScenes validation set**: *mAP* **71.5%**, *NDS* **73.6%** (inference latency only **+15 ms**), surpassing methods such as GraphBEV (70.1/72.9) and BEVDiffuser (69.2/71.9), and improving over the BEVFusion-PKU baseline by **+3.6 mAP / +2.6 NDS**; on **Argoverse2**, it achieves a competitive *mAP* of **41.7%**; ablations verify the gains of the three modules and the strong synergy between PGDC and DAGF (joint gain exceeds the sum of individual gains), and the method is **highly robust** to 2D prior quality—performance is almost unaffected under random priors, and replacing YOLOv9 priors with ground truth further improves to 73.5/74.2, indicating that performance scales with prior quality.

The method generates density heatmaps through a **lightweight density-focused extractor** to reduce feature redundancy, combines **masked window attention sparsification** to focus computational resources on effective regions, and adopts *progressive adaptive query initialization* to dynamically adjust query density, adapting to different object distribution scenarios without manual parameter tuning.

en.提出基于 3DGS 的实时动态场景渲染框架 **DASH**，针对平面法（4DG: Propose **DASH**, a real-time dynamic scene rendering framework based on 3DGS. To address the **feature overlap caused by the low-rank assumption** of the planar method (4DGaussian) and the **hash collisions and redundancy** caused by directly applying 4D hash encoding to the entire scene, design a **self-supervised dynamic-static decomposition mechanism**: leverage the inherent behavioral differences between static/dynamic elements during optimization (deformation magnitude under the linear motion model), automatically partition components using a *k*-th percentile threshold, and apply a static constraint loss, without manual annotation or precomputed masks; reconstruct static regions with standard 3DGS, and apply a **multi-resolution 4D hash encoder** only to dynamic regions, predicting position/rotation/scale deformation through quadrilinear interpolation and a multi-head decoder, avoiding the low-rank assumption and significantly reducing hash table overhead.
en.提出**时空平滑正则化**抑制显式表示固有的形变伪影：对 4D 坐标施加随机扰动: Propose **spatiotemporal smoothness regularization** to suppress deformation artifacts inherent in explicit representations: apply random perturbations to 4D coordinates, constrain the spatiotemporal consistency of encoded features within local neighborhoods, and ensure smooth deformation patterns of adjacent Gaussians; combined with adaptive density control and opacity reset mechanisms performed separately for dynamic/static Gaussians, this forms a complete optimizable framework (*L*₁ + D-SSIM + smoothness regularization).
en.在 **Neural 3D Video**（平均 *PSNR* **32.22: Achieve **SOTA** rendering quality on two real multi-view datasets, **Neural 3D Video** (average *PSNR* **32.22 dB**) and **Technicolor Light Field** (*PSNR* **33.94 dB**), outperforming representative methods such as 4DGaussian, Grid4D, and E-D3DGS; on a single RTX 4090, achieve real-time rendering at **264 FPS** (resolution 1352×1014). With hash table *O*(1) queries and a strategy of modeling only dynamic components, improve both quality and speed with fewer Gaussian points and shorter training time; ablations verify the necessity of decomposition, dynamic density control, and smoothness regularization components, and transferring the decomposition mechanism to Grid4D (Grid4D+dec) still brings significant *PSNR* gains, proving generality.

en.提出**首个基于 Mamba 的 3D 脉冲神经网络框架 SPM**，针对将 M: Propose **the first Mamba-based 3D spiking neural network framework, SPM**, addressing **temporal dynamics mismatch** (continuous state transitions vs. discrete spike events) and **spike information loss** when directly adapting Mamba to SNNs: design **hierarchical dynamic encoding (HDE)** to improve static direct encoding, injecting dynamic mechanisms in early (unstable) and late (redundant) stages of FPS sampling, preserving key intermediate information, and converting static point clouds into dynamic event-like representations; propose **spiking Mamba module (SMB)**, customizing the Gate branch and SSM branch for SNNs (SNN-friendly gating + time-flip bidirectional SSM), while maintaining Mamba's sequence modeling capability, learning cross-time-step features, and suppressing spike information loss.

en.提出面向生物医学视觉-语言模型的**双知识引导图提示学习框架 MeDKCoOp*: Propose **the dual knowledge-guided graph prompt learning framework MeDKCoOp** for biomedical vision-language models, addressing the problems of **insufficient utilization of specialized knowledge and lack of cross-modal structural relationship modeling** in CoOp-style prompt learning in the medical field; simultaneously mine domain-specific knowledge from **both text and vision branches** and formalize it as **graph-structured representations**, providing structured knowledge priors for prompt optimization in downstream medical tasks.
en.设计**知识引导的关系迁移机制**实现跨模态融合：以图结构为载体在视觉-文本模态: Design a **knowledge-guided relational transfer mechanism** to achieve cross-modal fusion: use graph structures as carriers to transfer domain knowledge between vision and text modalities, and **dynamically optimize learnable prompts** through a relational learning process, enabling CLIP-style models to acquire domain adaptation capability in medical image-text alignment while retaining their zero-shot generalization advantage.
en.在**多个生物医学基准**上相比 CoOp 等提示学习基线取得**更优性能**，: On **multiple biomedical benchmarks**, achieve **better performance** than prompt learning baselines such as CoOp, especially with significant improvements in the **base-to-new class generalization** task, indicating that the method improves novel-class generalization while maintaining base-class discriminative ability, and validating the effectiveness of structured knowledge priors for medical prompt learning.

en.设计两大运动感知组件：**时序运动引导 TMG** 借助平滑相机轨迹得到稀疏运动: Design two motion-aware components: **Temporal Motion Guidance (TMG)** uses smoothed camera trajectories to obtain sparse motion fields and generates coarsely aligned frames via motion-guided warping as structural guidance, decoupling global motion compensation from content generation.
